title: refactor(channel): one join path; every WRONG_PASSWORD notice pauses retries
expect: rejoin|remember(s|ed)? the channel|without the password|not (an answer|ours|from us)|lastJoinAt|foreign|unrelated|stale notice
why: Reverse of 6ff04fb. A WRONG_PASSWORD notice that answers no join of ours comes from the client rejoining the remembered channel without the password; treating it as a failed join of ours holds the addon off the channel for minutes after every login.
